text: Pilots or vehicle drivers who are lost or uncertain of their position on the aerodrome maneuvering area will stop and notify the ATS unit of the circumstances, including their last known position. However, if the pilot or vehicle driver recognizes that they are on a runway and are able to locate a nearby suitable taxiway, they should vacate the runway as expeditiously as possible. Question. What will pilots or vehicle drivers do if they are on the runway?
